crop.notes: Clipping has the headline and the opening Corbett-Fitzsimmons interview only. The paragraph about Mace wanting to fight Allen is further down the same 'Gossip of the Boxers' column and is clipped separately as article 907.

ocr.notes: Minor errors (Msht for fight, how for unfair).

title.suggested: Status of the Corbett-Fitzsimmons Match; Mace Wants to Fight Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic's New York boxing letter, mostly on the Corbett-Fitzsimmons match, carried a subhead saying Jem Mace wanted to fight Tom Allen and Prof. Bill Clark.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Sunday Morning, February 24, 1895, page 11. Dateline New York, Feb. 22.

notes: Same article as 907; consider merging the two or recropping 906 to include the Mace/Allen paragraph. Facts recorded on 907.
